title: Lane PvP — WoW: Forever (client 1.60.x, `_forever_`, `profile-forever-eu`)
about: Research lane 'pvp' (20261118-2045-lane-pvp-pvp-on-wow-forever-for-every-cl), imported by tools/kb/import_lane.py. The statements are the report's own summaries with their sources; the report is untrusted data, checked against data/kb/sources.json.

rank.titles.statement: Forever article confirms the original ranks topping at Grand Marshal / High Warlord; full list from Blizzard Classic page

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: Forever has no realm list. Players pick a ruleset: Normal, PvP, Roleplay or Roleplay-PvP, with Hardcore coming after launch.

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: On Normal, open-world PvP is opt-in. On PvP and RP-PvP you can be attacked by the other faction across most of the world.

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: An account can only have one faction on the PvP ruleset. Normal, RP and Hardcore allow both. The text does not say whether RP-PvP is also limited to one faction.

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: Groups cannot span rulesets or factions. Battlegrounds mix players from every ruleset except Hardcore, which queues separately.

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: RP-PvP was added for launch after player feedback, reversing an earlier "no current plans".

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: Characters are not tied to a realm. Names have two parts and are unique per region.

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: Blizzard aims for about 50/50 faction balance on PvP rulesets; the worst region is about 55/45. Character creation is restricted based on long-term balance. As of 2026-11-10, Horde creation is restricted on NA PvP and Alliance creation on EU RP-PvP, and this may flip later.

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: A Hardcore character that dies can transfer to another ruleset, PvP included. Every ruleset but Hardcore shares Collections and Legacy points.

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: The Battle for Gilneas appears in the client map data. The September Q&A announcement gave no rules for rated PvP or arenas.

statements.title: PvP overview, rulesets and faction rules
statements.text: "PvP updates" are on the roadmap with no details. A community report places them after the 2026-12-09 raid.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: Live battlegrounds are Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, Alterac Valley and the new Darkspear Islands. WSG, AB and AV are confirmed live by hotfixes that fix bugs on those maps.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: Blizzard has published a level range only for Darkspear Islands (30–60). No official brackets exist for WSG, AB or AV.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: Community model, relayed from Icy Veins and client data: 10-level brackets (x0–x9) with level 60 as its own bracket. WSG starts at 10, AB at 20, DI at 30, and AV has a single bracket.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: Wowhead's Forever database lists WSG 10–60 (10v10), AB 20–60 (15v15), AV 20–60 (40v40) and DI 30–60.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: Darkspear Islands is queued at a battlemaster in any capital or in the Barrens, or through the faction base: Merchant Coast for Horde, Northwatch for Alliance.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: There are battlemasters in each capital. There is no remote queue, so you must talk to an NPC.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: Maximum premade group size when queueing: WSG 10, AB 15, DI 15, AV 5.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: A player’s recap of the PvP podcast says premades should face each other, with solo players and small groups in a separate pool. The recap treats war games as a possible later addition.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: A player’s recap says the developers would consider timers for very long battleground matches. The recap gives no time limit.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: The beta was capped at level 30, so AV and the level-60 brackets were never tested before launch.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: Deserter debuff: no Forever-specific duration is known. A 2026-11-03 note shortens a "quitter debuff" to 40 s (was 5 min), but that debuff belongs to the Legacy toy "Replica Ironforge Air Rifle", not to battlegrounds.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: Deserter was added in 1.9.0. It blocks battleground queueing after you leave early, and the wiki does not give a duration.

statements.title: Battlegrounds: roster, queueing, brackets, matchmaking
statements.text: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: Classic Era brackets are WSG 10–19…60, AB 20–29…60, and AV a single 51–60 bracket.

statements.title: Warsong Gulch
statements.text: Live. A hotfix removed an invisible wall on the Alliance base roof.

statements.title: Warsong Gulch
statements.text: Players can no longer mount in the starting rooms.

statements.title: Warsong Gulch
statements.text: Tauren Plainsrunning can't stack during the preparation phase, its stacks drop when the Tauren carries a flag, and it can't stack while carrying one.

statements.title: Warsong Gulch
statements.text: Reputations are Silverwing Sentinels (Alliance) and Warsong Outriders (Horde). The level-19 turn-in "Battle of Warsong Gulch" takes 3 marks.

statements.title: Warsong Gulch
statements.text: Reputation quartermasters: Illyana Moonblaze (Alliance, Ashenvale 61.6, 83.8) and Kelm Hargunth (Horde, Barrens 46.7, 8.4).

statements.title: Arathi Basin
statements.text: Live. Dying in the Gold Mine no longer sends players to a "Riverglades" graveyard.

statements.title: Arathi Basin
statements.text: 15v15 with 5 resource nodes; the first team to 2,000 resources wins.

statements.title: Arathi Basin
statements.text: Levels 20–60, with brackets 20–29 … 60.

statements.title: Arathi Basin
statements.text: Reputations are League of Arathor (Alliance) and The Defilers (Horde). Quartermasters are Samuel Hawke (Alliance, 46.0, 45.6) and Rutherford Twing (Horde, 73.6, 29.8).

statements.title: Alterac Valley
statements.text: Live. The "Battle for Alterac Valley" quests now need level 58 to accept, to match high-level quests elsewhere.

statements.title: Alterac Valley
statements.text: Blizzard reviewed Honor across battlegrounds so that AV is not the only efficient choice.

statements.title: Alterac Valley
statements.text: Podcast: AV Honor goes down and Honor in every other battleground goes up.

statements.title: Alterac Valley
statements.text: Creature stuns now have diminishing returns (the hotfix is not specific to AV, but it matters for NPC-heavy AV).

statements.title: Alterac Valley
statements.text: 40v40. You win by killing the enemy general (Vanndar Stormpike or Drek'Thar), and burning towers or bunkers removes the officers guarding him.

statements.title: Alterac Valley
statements.text: The level range is disputed: one bracket of 51–60 according to Icy Veins (relayed) and client data, or 20–60 in Wowhead's Forever database. See Contradictions C1.

statements.title: Alterac Valley
statements.text: Reputations are Stormpike Guard (Alliance) and Frostwolf Clan (Horde). Quartermasters are Thanthaldis Snowgleam (Alliance) and Jekyll Flandring (Horde).

statements.title: Alterac Valley
statements.text: The Exalted rewards and quest rewards are claimed to match Classic (e.g. Don Julio's Band, Ice Barbed Spear), with no citation.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: A new 15v15 battleground off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh, for player levels 30–60.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: Four capture points; holding more of them scores points faster. A central flag carried to any base your team holds gives extra points. The first team to 2,000 points wins.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: The factions are Darkspear Raiders (Horde, base at Merchant Coast) and Theramore Expeditionary Force (Alliance, base at Northwatch), each with its own reputation track.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: Base vendors sell trinkets, rings, cloaks, weapons, armor and consumables, unlocked by reputation level. Marks of Honor are turned in on reputation quests. Exalted unlocks a short questline that rewards a faction tabard.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: Capture-point subzones: Abandoned Tower, Camp, Ruins and Shipwreck Cove.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: Whoever drops the flag no longer gets the Recently Dropped Flag debuff.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: Darkspear Islands has its own mark (item 274895). Turning in 3 marks ("Conflict at Darkspear Islands" for Horde, "Darkspear Islands Clash" for Alliance) gives 150 reputation plus Honor.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: The win quest "The Battle for Darkspear Islands!" (Horde, handed in to Nizook Boof) gives Honor plus 200 reputation.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: Quartermasters: Bryanna Embreeze (Alliance, Barrens 63.5, 58.8) and Creeg Bothunk (Horde, Barrens 65.1, 34.5).

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: The Darkspear signet rings' MP5 was corrected to match the Alliance rings.

statements.title: Battle for the Darkspear Islands (new)
statements.text: Reputation gear comes in bracket versions at item levels 33/43/53/63. Items are gated at Friendly, Honored and Exalted; Exalted includes gloves, shoulders and a battle tabard. Rations and bandages that work only inside Darkspear Islands exist at levels 25/35/45.

statements.title: Marks of Honor
statements.text: Battleground Marks of Honor now stack to 30 (was 20).

statements.title: Marks of Honor
statements.text: Marks are turned in on reputation quests that raise battleground reputation.

statements.title: Marks of Honor
statements.text: Marks awarded: 3 for a win and 1 for a loss. No Blizzard text says this; it traces back to Icy Veins.

statements.title: Marks of Honor
statements.text:
Marks are also a co-currency for PvP gear, by slot, according to the September beta vendor data:
• WSG marks: wrists, hands, legs.
• AB marks: shoulders, chest, belt, cloak.
• DI marks: feet, necklace, one-handers, ranged, off-hand/shield.
• AV marks: head and two-handers.

statements.title: Marks of Honor
statements.text: A forum player says mark turn-ins give XP; others say they give none (see KB-PVP-13).

statements.title: Marks of Honor
statements.text: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: vanilla gave 3 marks for a win, 2 for a draw (added later), 1 for a loss, and none for leaving early. Marks were turned in at battleground quests for Honor and reputation.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: PvP progression has two parts, Honor and Rank Points, and is described as a simplified take on the original honor system.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: Honor comes from killing enemy players, completing battlegrounds and doing relevant PvP quests, and is spent on PvP gear.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: The battleground on its holiday week gives more Honor (and more Rank Points). Neither the bonus size nor the schedule has been published.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: Season weekly tasks (the "journey") give Honor and Rank Points.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: The Honor cap was raised from 15,000 to 25,000.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: Killing a player while at the Honor cap no longer shows any Honor gained, which means nothing is awarded at the cap.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: Community sources say Honor above the cap is lost, there is no weekly limit on earning Honor, Honor and Rank Points never convert into each other, and spending Honor does not lower your rank.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: The Legacy perk "For Great Honor" (Resourcefulness tree) increases Honor gained from PvP. Beta data puts it at +2% per rank, 5 ranks, so up to +10%.

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: No official Honor values per kill, win or quest. No official diminishing returns for repeat kills and no dishonorable kills (a community audit of the client found none).

statements.title: Honor (currency)
statements.text: Datamined IDs: Honor currency 1792, Rank Point currency 3468, hidden faction 2800 "PvP Rank Points". The season label in the data is "Season 36", probably an internal number.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Rank Points come from battlegrounds, relevant PvP quests and season weekly tasks, with a holiday-week boost. Player kills are not listed as a source.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: The launch overview also mentions Honor and Rank Points from "other PvP activities", without detail.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: The 14 original ranks remain, topping out at High Warlord (Horde) and Grand Marshal (Alliance).

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Rank progress has a weekly cap, with no value given.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Rank, Rank Points and the rewards you can buy appear under the Player vs. Player tab of the character pane.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: PvP runs in seasons, and each season has a journey of weekly tasks.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Rank goes back to the bottom each season or content patch, and players can climb to Rank 14 again. The system combines TBC-style seasons with vanilla ranks (Tim Jones, Kotaku interview).

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Rank Points fill one cumulative bar for the season. There is no realm-standing bracket calculation and no decay within a season.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Datamined rank thresholds: 750, 900, 1,050, 1,200, 1,350, 1,500, 1,650, 1,800, 1,950, 2,100, 2,350, 2,500, 2,650 and 3,000 RP per rank, for a total of 24,750. The full table is below.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: The weekly cap limits your total season RP and rises each week. RP earned above the current cap does not count, so Rank 14 is reachable in week 10 at the earliest.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Season length has not been announced; community estimates are 20–25 weeks. Rank and RP reset at season end, while bought items and Legacy points are kept (community).

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Players reported that their PvP ranks stopped progressing after rank 3.

statements.title: Rank Points, ranks, weekly cap, seasons
statements.text: Blizzard traced the EU PvE battleground queue delays to one ruleset server. The regional restart was due to pick up its fix.

statements.title: Rank rewards, Emboldened Seals, vendors and costs
statements.text:
Rewards by rank:
• R1: tabard
• R2: PvP trinket
• R3: cloaks
• R4: necklace
• R5: combat potions
• R6: tabard
• R7: battle standard
• R8: epic bracers and belt upgrade tokens
• R9: epic boots token
• R10: epic gloves token
• R11: mounts
• R12: epic legs and shoulders tokens
• R13: epic chest and helm tokens
• R14: epic weapons

statements.title: Rank rewards, Emboldened Seals, vendors and costs
statements.text: Honor prices for most PvP gear and upgrade tokens went up about 50%.

statements.title: Rank rewards, Emboldened Seals, vendors and costs
statements.text: PvP vendors were "temporarily unavailable" in every location (Orgrimmar, Stormwind, Dalaran). No fix appears in the hotfixes up to 2026-11-17, and a player thread on 2026-11-10 still reports empty halls.

statements.title: Rank rewards, Emboldened Seals, vendors and costs
statements.text:
Vendors:
• Stormwind Champions' Hall (76.0, 66.2): Captain Dirgehammer (armor), Captain O'Neal (weapons), Master Sergeant Biggins (accessories), Lieutenant Karter (mounts).
• Orgrimmar Hall of Legends (40.6, 68.5): Lady Palanseer (armor), Sergeant Thunderhorn (weapons), Brave Stonehide (accessories), Raider Bork (mounts).
• Dalaran Underbelly: three vendors, with no mount vendor.

statements.title: Rank rewards, Emboldened Seals, vendors and costs
statements.text:
Item names (datamined):
• R5: Combat Healing and Combat Mana Potion.
• R6: Knight's Colors / Stone Guard's Herald.
• R8–R13 seals: "Premier Emboldened [slot] Seal".
• R11: Black War mounts.
• R7 battle standard: +15% health to nearby allies, 10-minute cooldown.

statements.title: Rank rewards, Emboldened Seals, vendors and costs
statements.text: Rare set ("Premier …"): item level 60, requires level 55, no rank requirement. Epic ("Elite") set: item level 65, requires level 60. R14 weapons: 22 Premier Grand Marshal's / High Warlord's weapons at item level 65, bought with Honor and no gold.

statements.title: Rank rewards, Emboldened Seals, vendors and costs
statements.text:
September beta prices, before the +50% change, as Honor plus marks / seal Honor:
• Cloak: 3,000 + 10 AB.
• Wrist: 3,000 + 10 WSG / 750.
• Belt: 4,000 + 10 AB / 1,000.
• Boots: 5,000 + 10 DI / 1,000.
• Gloves: 5,000 + 10 WSG / 1,500.
• Shoulders: 4,250 + 10 AB / 1,500.
• Legs: 6,000 + 15 WSG / 2,000.
• Helm: 6,000 + 15 AV.
• Chest: 6,250 + 15 AB / 1,750.
• Two-hander: 15,000 + 20 AV.
• One-hander or ranged: 8,000 + 10 DI.
• Shield or off-hand: 7,000 + 10 DI.
• Trinket: 3,500.
• Necklace: 5,000 + 10 DI.
**Out of date; use only to compare items against each other.**

statements.title: PvP gear per class and role
statements.text: New and reworked PvP items fill gaps for specs that had none; for example, Shaman get healer, melee and caster sets.

statements.title: PvP gear per class and role
statements.text: Claims that the rare set has 8 pieces including bracers and belt (Classic had 6), and that Elite epics only change appearance with the same stats, are both unverified.

statements.title: PvP gear per class and role
statements.text:
CLASSIC_FALLBACK, rare sets (Lieutenant Commander's for Alliance, Champion's for Horde):
• Druid: Refuge
• Hunter: Pursuance
• Mage: Arcanum
• Paladin: Redoubt (Alliance)
• Priest: Investiture
• Rogue: Guard
• Shaman: Stormcaller (Horde)
• Warlock: Dreadgear
• Warrior: Battlearmor

statements.title: PvP gear per class and role
statements.text:
CLASSIC_FALLBACK, epic sets (Field Marshal's for Alliance, Warlord's for Horde):
• Druid: Sanctuary
• Hunter: Pursuit
• Mage: Regalia
• Priest: Raiment
• Rogue: Vestments
• Warlock: Threads
• Warrior: Battlegear
• Paladin: Aegis (Alliance)
• Shaman: Earthshaker (Horde)
Rank gates in Classic 1.12: rare R7 (gloves/boots), R8 (chest/legs), R10 (helm/shoulders); epic R12 (gloves/legs/boots), R13 (helm/chest/shoulders); R14 weapons.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: Blizzard has announced no new world PvP objectives. None of the PvP, ruleset or launch articles mention any.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: World kills give Honor, but they are not a listed Rank Point source. A community source says they give no RP.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: Dalaran: Horde players are attacked on sight and the Horde sewer key no longer gives open-world access to the city. The City of Dalaran dungeon is unaffected.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: Using Sap on a PvP-flagged target now flags the Rogue. The Mulgore "Sparring Match" quest no longer flags players.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: Blizzard lowered the player cap in crowded zones, especially on PvP realms. During beta, changing a party could move its leader to another layer. The Oct 1 update addressed that problem for party leaders.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: Players report layer changes interrupting world PvP, for example escaping a fight by crossing a zone border.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: A community claim, unverified: Riverglades and Shen'dralas are contested zones, and PvP-ruleset characters get flagged as soon as they enter a contested or enemy zone.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: CLASSIC_FALLBACK, Silithus: carry Silithyst from geysers to your faction's camp. Carrying it flags you and slows you, and mounting drops it. Delivering 200 gives the faction a zone buff.

statements.title: World PvP
statements.text: CLASSIC_FALLBACK, Eastern Plaguelands: holding the four towers (Crown Guard, Eastwall, Northpass, Plaguewood) gives a damage bonus against Undead in the zone and in Stratholme. The tower quests are "Bolstering Our Defenses" (Horde) and "Establishing New Outposts" (Alliance).

statements.title: PvP while levelling (battleground XP, brackets, twinks)
statements.text: No official source mentions XP from battlegrounds: not the PvP article, the Darkspear Islands article, any dev notes from 09-24 to 11-03, or any hotfix from 11-05 to 11-17.

statements.title: PvP while levelling (battleground XP, brackets, twinks)
statements.text: Players disagree. One says the only XP comes from 3-mark turn-in quests; others say there is none at all. Blizzard has not replied. A player thread on 11-18 says marks no longer give XP at level 42.

statements.title: PvP while levelling (battleground XP, brackets, twinks)
statements.text: The only official levelling boost is dungeon kill XP +50% (11-09). Dungeon kills give no XP if the enemy is trivial for any party member (11-13).

statements.title: PvP while levelling (battleground XP, brackets, twinks)
statements.text: No XP lock or "Experience Eliminator" has been announced; players have asked for one. A community inference suggests 30–39 as the likely twink bracket because Darkspear Islands reputation gear starts around required level 28.

statements.title: PvP while levelling (battleground XP, brackets, twinks)
statements.text: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: vanilla battleground matches and honorable kills gave no XP. Objective XP and the XP-off option arrived in 3.2.0. Vanilla mark turn-in quests did give XP, for example about 6,400–6,600 XP around level 40.

statements.title: PvP while levelling (battleground XP, brackets, twinks)
statements.text: CLASSIC_FALLBACK (SoD): in 2024 Blizzard purged stockpiled WSG marks because players were saving them to turn in for fast levelling.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: Critical strikes in PvP no longer have reduced effect; the beta's PvP crit reduction was removed.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: Roots from procs now have diminishing returns: Frostbite, Entrapment, Improved Wing Clip, Counterattack, Improved Hamstring.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: Creature stuns now correctly have diminishing returns. The Cooldown Manager shows CC durations correctly, DR included.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: Hit and crit are merged across spell, melee and ranged. Bonus healing also gives bonus damage equal to a third of its value.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text:
Racial changes:
• Will of the Forsaken no longer gives immunity to Charm, Fear and Sleep.
• Stoneform reduces physical damage taken instead of adding armor.
• Each race has two active and two passive racials.
• Gnome Confounding Flash and Dwarf Chastise are racials for Priests.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text:
Racial numbers:
• Blood Fury cooldown 2 min (was 3).
• Berserking 15 s.
• Touch of the Grave internal cooldown 15 s (was 25); it no longer breaks CC.
• Plainsrunning 2% per stack up to 60%, no mounted speed.
• Human Ruthless 1% crit.
• New Dwarf Artisan's Precision, +1% hit.
• Orc Savage and Dwarf Earth Fury removed.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: Undead lose Will of the Forsaken while under Scatter Shot.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: The Might of Stormwind and Warchief's Blessing buffs now end on death and no longer apply to non-players.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: Talents use one-point "gold medal" milestones at 11, 16, 21 and 31 points. Dual spec unlocks at level 40.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: All classes got more power before launch, and every class had large talent reworks.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: Paladin and Shaman are available to both factions. Paladin races: Human, Dwarf, Undead. Shaman races: Orc, Tauren, Troll, Windshaper Skyborne, Dwarf.

statements.title: Combat rules, crowd control and diminishing returns, racials (all classes)
statements.text: Skill Capped's overall PvP tiers at launch: S Rogue, Warlock; A Druid, Hunter, Mage, Priest; B Paladin, Shaman; C Warrior.

statements.title: … 23 — Class documents
statements.text: Spearing Strike (Arms 16-point medal) dismounts the target and does double damage to mounted targets. Bloodthirst no longer heals, and Victory Rush heals 10%. Iron Will shortens stuns.

statements.title: … 23 — Class documents
statements.text: Protection is intended as a PvP utility secondary spec.

statements.title: … 23 — Class documents
statements.text:
Pre-launch changes:
• Improved Tactical Mastery is now 3 points.
• Bloodthrill is new: chance to enable Overpower.
• Slam has a 15 s cooldown.
• Flurry no longer requires Death Wish, while Bloodthirst now does.

statements.title: … 23 — Class documents
statements.text: Recommended build: Arms 32/19/0 with Mortal Strike, Sweeping Strikes, Weaponmaster (new), Improved Hamstring and Piercing Howl. Plays as a midfield melee that dismounts healers and flag carriers. Weak against kiting. Tier C.

statements.title: … 23 — Class documents
statements.text: No interrupt and no slow. Voice of Truth (Holy 11-point) gives 6 s of immunity to silence and interrupts on a 3-min cooldown. Repentance is a 21-point Retribution talent. Templar's Bulwark applies Forbearance.

statements.title: … 23 — Class documents
statements.text:
Pre-launch changes:
• Divine Precision shortens silences by 10/20%.
• New Stoicism shortens stuns and charms by 10/20%.
• Sacred Duty shortens Forbearance by 5/10 s.
• Templar's Bulwark can now be dispelled.
• Salvation, Mass Salvation and Blessing of Light are removed.
• Unsealed Wrath is the new 31-point Retribution talent.

statements.title: … 23 — Class documents

statements.title: Consumables and professions for PvP
statements.text: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: Engineering is the main PvP profession (grenades, sappers, nets, rocket helmet). Free Action, Limited Invulnerability, Restorative and Swiftness potions plus bandages are PvP staples.

statements.title: PvP and Legacy points
statements.text:
PvP Legacy Challenges are worth 12 points in total:
• Reaching ranks 3, 7, 10, 13 and 14: 5 points.
• Exalted with each battleground reputation: 4 points.
• Week 4, 7 and 10 quests of the Field of Honor PvP Season's Journey: 3 points.

statements.title: PvP and Legacy points
statements.text: Three season tasks per season give a Legacy point. Because they belong to the Legacy system, they stay available in later seasons.

statements.title: PvP and Legacy points
statements.text: PvP Legacy Challenges can't be completed on Hardcore, which has 12 challenges of its own.

statements.title: PvP and Legacy points
statements.text: Legacy points are shared across the Battle.net account for non-Hardcore characters, and each character spends them separately, up to 16 at launch.

statements.title: PvP and Legacy points
statements.text: Legacy rewards are cosmetic or prestige and give no competitive advantage.

statements.title: PvP and Legacy points
statements.text: The four battleground reputation pairs: Frostwolf/Stormpike (AV), Defilers/League of Arathor (AB), Warsong Outriders/Silverwing Sentinels (WSG), Darkspear Raiders/Theramore Expeditionary Force (DI).

statements.title: PvP and Legacy points
statements.text: Each challenge counts once per account, and all 12 can be done on one character. Earliest weeks under the datamined cap: R3 in week 1, R7 in week 4, R10 in week 7, R13 in week 9, R14 in week 10.

statements.title: PvP and Legacy points
statements.text: PvP-adjacent perks: For Great Honor (more Honor); High Alert (stealth detection outside battlegrounds); Field Medicine (shorter Recently Bandaged, not in battlegrounds).

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: Classic Era honor system
statements.text: Honorable kills count only against players within 10 levels; higher-rank victims are worth more.

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: Classic Era honor system
statements.text: Patch 1.14.4 removed Rank Points and de-ranking: rank progress depends only on your own weekly honor, capped at 500,000 honor a week.

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: Classic Era honor system
statements.text: Honor decay was turned off in Era and SoD from 2023-12-05; dishonorable kills are the only way to lose progress.

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: Classic Era honor system
statements.text: Before 1.14.4: a weekly standing ladder with 20% weekly RP decay, a 13,000 RP weekly maximum and a 15-HK weekly minimum.

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: battlegrounds, world PvP, Hardcore, SoD
statements.text: WSG: 10v10, first to 3 captures, minimum level 10. AV: 40v40, minimum level 51.

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: battlegrounds, world PvP, Hardcore, SoD
statements.text: AB: 15v15, brackets 20–29 up to 60.

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: battlegrounds, world PvP, Hardcore, SoD
statements.text: Battleground holiday weekends rotate between WSG, AB and AV, and the featured map gives extra honor and reputation (added in 1.13.4).

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: battlegrounds, world PvP, Hardcore, SoD
statements.text: Hardcore: battlegrounds and the honor system are off; you flag only with /pvp; wargames give no honor; duels to the death are opt-in.

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: battlegrounds, world PvP, Hardcore, SoD
statements.text: SoD: rank was capped per phase (R3 at level 25, rising to R14 with Ahn'Qiraj), and there were world events in Ashenvale and Blood Moon in Stranglethorn.

statements.title: CLASSIC_FALLBACK: battlegrounds, world PvP, Hardcore, SoD
statements.text: SoD changed how many marks losers get several times in 2024: an experiment with 2 marks was reverted to 1, then losers got marks based on their performance.
Trial accounts and level-1 characters do not affect the faction-balance creation lock.
Honor no longer decides rank. Rank points come from daily and weekly sources, weekly battlegrounds, Season Journey quests and some world PvP events (Gurubashi).
Rank determines which PvP rewards are unlocked, and Honor is the currency spent to buy them.
Low ranks give rare-quality PvP gear. From Rank 8 it can be upgraded to epic, and Rank 14 unlocks epic weapons that match raid gear.
The weekly Season Journey quest is the biggest source of rank points and has catch-up. Max rank is expected around the middle of a season.
Some EU players report that battleground queues never pop on certain layers. Getting moved to another layer, for example via a friend's group, may help.
Alterac Valley awards its long-match reputation bonus after 20 minutes. Holding graveyards and mines at the finish matters for that bonus.
Alterac Valley shifted rewards from the enemy general to objectives. Taking towers, graveyards and mines earns more reputation. Killing lieutenants also grants more reputation.
Loot Storm Crystals before leaving Alterac Valley. Uncollected quest items from the battleground no longer arrive by mail.
For the first 20 minutes in Alterac Valley, the general and defending officers start with four stacks of a combat buff. Capturing an objective removes one stack.
Alterac Valley marshals and warmasters reset if pulled out of their rooms. They spot attackers from farther away, and generals can detect stealthed players more easily.

open_questions.text: **Numbers:** Honor and Rank Points per kill, per battleground win or loss, per quest and per weekly task. The holiday-week bonus percentage and the rotation schedule. The weekly RP cap value (only datamined beta values exist). Official RP thresholds.

**Seasons:** season 1 length and end date. Whether unspent Honor and marks reset. Whether gear stays usable across seasons. The Field of Honor weekly reset timing, and whether its "weeks" are calendar weeks of the season or counted per character.

**Battlegrounds:** official brackets for WSG, AB and DI. AV's queue minimum (51, 20 or 58). Deserter duration, AFK reporting, match timers. Whether random battleground queues are live. Whether the Classic world entrances to battlegrounds exist. Exact reputation per turn-in for WSG, AB and AV. Full reputation reward lists.
**Battleground XP:** whether matches or mark turn-ins give XP, and how much per bracket. Whether an XP lock or twink matchmaking is planned.
**Honor rules:** whether diminishing returns for repeat kills, dishonorable kills, or a grey-kill honor rule exist. Whether world kills give Rank Points.
**Rank perks:** whether officer-area access, the 10% discount or World Defense chat exist in Forever.

**Gear:** live Honor and mark prices after the +50% change. Official set names and bonuses per class and spec, including Horde names. Number of pieces per set. Elite versus blue stats. Whether the PvP vendors have been restored since 2026-11-05. Where Horde can buy, given that Dalaran is hostile to them.

**World PvP:** whether the Eastern Plaguelands towers and Silithus are live. The official list of contested zones (Riverglades, Shen'dralas?). How auto-flagging works on the PvP ruleset. Whether RP-PvP is also limited to one faction per account.

**Classes:** level-60 PvP builds for Holy Paladin and Restoration Druid. Any Restoration Shaman guide from a known author. Whether any PvP-specific damage or healing modifier exists besides the removed crit reduction.

**Data access:** wago.tools db2 tables (TraitTree, TraitNode, PvpRank, CurrencyTypes, ItemSet) for the forever branch could not be read; every request returned HTTP 403. Icy Veins also returned 403, and Wowhead's Forever database and article bodies render with JavaScript. Every "datamined" fact here is second-hand via third-party sites. Reading those db2 tables directly is the top follow-up.
**Rated PvP and arenas:** no written official statement. The unreleased client rows (Mak'gora Arena, Battle for Gilneas, Battle for Blackrock) have no announcement.
**Bugs:** Blizzard has not acknowledged player reports that ranks stop progressing after rank 3.
